title: Hatsune Miku — Marks With A Message〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's awesome.
You really get to be on TV again?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<But you all should hurry.
I'm sure the producer's eagerly awaiting your arrival.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Then, we should head back to SEKAI.
Tell us how things go later, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
We'll talk again soon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Bye bye!>
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're back♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Miku♪
Oh, would you mind welcoming me back as well?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sure.
Luka, Rin, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line: We're back♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was a lot of fun.
We got to see four houses today!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were hoping to talk more about the houses with Minori and the others...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that'll have to wait since they received a work offer.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that producer must really like them if they were personally asked to fill in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I hope things go well for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
They'll be fine♪
Right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! I'm sure they'll come visit right after their meeting's finished, so let's just keep believing in them for now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Still, that might not be for a while...
Wanna do something until then?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We already practiced singing and dancing before we went to meet them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Or we could have another practice right now♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Eep! A-Another practice?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Just kidding♪ I know we're all very tired...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness. You had me going there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're so mean. I thought you were actually being serious.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Another practice...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The floor's all scratched up...
Does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <The previous tenants also practiced here?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, everyone...?
Can I have you all come with me for a second?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, what are we doing on this stage...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you planning on practicing more?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
Miku, didn't you hear just now?! MEIKO was joking!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I know.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanted to talk about a room from the fourth house we went to today. The floor was all scratched up like someone had been practicing there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like someone had been practicing there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, and some scratches looked newer than the others. Aside from scratches, there were also some dents and bumps.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But all those things made the room seem like it was filled with hope for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In other words, the previous tenants practiced enough to leave their mark on that house.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And the stages in SEKAI are no different.
They're all scratched up from us doing so many shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example, there was that time we crashed into each other on this one.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! I remember that! Talk about a blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, what happened exactly?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku and Rin had trouble mastering the formation for this one dance. They ended up having a bit of a nasty crash during practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Which caused me to drop my mic...
Oh, I think this is the spot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, here!
We panicked so much...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We both apologized to each other, asked if we were okay, checked to see if the mic was and what happened to the floor!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is news to me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think this part got scraped during another one of our dance practices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, the lights make it hard to see, but there are just so many little scratches.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow...
I never would've noticed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born out of Minori and the others' feelings, but it's nice to see how we've been able to leave our mark on this place...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I hope we get to keep doing that as we cheer them on in the future.)
